description: Sends Direct Hotels a hotel it does not list, for review. Use when the user names a hotel that search_hotels and get_hotel did not find and wants it added. We check the hotel's own website before listing it (usually within minutes, otherwise after a manual review), so a suggestion is not yet a listing. The website, when known, is what we verify against. Stores the hotel's details only, nothing about the user.

client.description: Optional: your product or agent name, e.g. "Claude". Not used by the tool; recorded only for the public count of which assistants use the directory.

website.description: The hotel's own website, not a booking platform.

name: suggest_hotel
title: Suggest a missing hotel
